ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 20-C in the
area bound by:

South East End Avenue; East 79" Street; a line 125.0 feet east of and parallel to South
East End Avenue; the public alley next south of and parallel to East 79" Street,

to those of a RS-1, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

My, heme

Michelle Harris
Alderperson, 8" Ward

Common Address:
1701-11 E. 79" Street
